summary: Onboarding request: real-time audit stream handoff + SOC ingestion evidence for GlacierHealth
summary_template: Customer requests continuous delivery of normalized audit events and a packaged evidence bundle for SOC ingestion and regulatory review.
description: Issue summary: GlacierHealth (enterprise, healthcare) is onboarding Redwood audit events into their centralized SIEM and SOC. They require a persistent, TLS-mutual-auth authenticated delivery channel, a mapping document for fields and PII redaction guidance, sample payloads for testing, and an evidence bundle to satisfy their compliance team for SOC 2 and HIPAA intake. Impact: Without these artifacts they cannot complete SOC onboarding and will delay go-live of internal workflows that rely on full auditability.
impact: Customer unable to complete SOC ingestion and compliance verification for production workloads; potential go-live delay for key healthcare integrations.
requested_artifacts: sample encrypted export (30 minutes of events)
TLS mTLS certificate thumbprint + rotation policy doc
S3/SFTP delivery runbook with retry semantics
signed attestation letter for log integrity (HMAC/X509)
delivery_requirements: Prefer push-based HTTP with mTLS and client cert rotation. If push not possible, a scheduled SFTP drop with manifest and GPG-signed manifest is acceptable. Events must include tenant scoping and request-level identifiers.
steps_to_reproduce: N/A - this is a configuration and evidence request rather than a functional bug. Initial test flow: 1) Customer shares staging mTLS client cert and test endpoint. 2) Redwood configures a dedicated export route. 3) Customer validates sample payloads and mapping. 4) Customer requests evidence bundle for SOC intake.
logs_and_artifacts_provided_by_customer: Customer provided staging endpoint and internal SOC contact (scon@glacierhealth.com). They also attached an onboarding checklist in Slack #support-glacierhealth thread (link in comments).
estimated_tat: We indicated 5 business days for initial test payloads and 10 business days for full evidence package, depending on scheduling with security team.

resolution_plan: 1) Provision dedicated export route with mTLS to customer's staging endpoint. 2) Produce 30-minute sample export and field-mapping spreadsheet, including PII redaction guidance. 3) Generate signed attestation document for log integrity (HMAC thumbprint + X.509 metadata) and include rotation policy. 4) Deliver packaged evidence bundle (PDF + signed manifests) and runbook. 5) Hand off to Customer Success for go/no-go and closure.
workarounds: Short-term: Provide SFTP drop with GPG-signed manifest and temporary staging payloads while mTLS provisioning completes.
resolution: Pending - evidence bundle work scheduled; mTLS provisioning started and sample payloads delivered to staging on 2026-03-05.
